name: Wavestride
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You move water from a large source within short range. The water surrounds you, enhancing your movement. Uncheck any number of Conditions. For each Condition you unchecked (twice for Insecure), choose one:

  • Your Speed increases by 15 ft.

  • The water may lift you in the air 15 ft.

You may choose each option multiple times. The effects are cumulative.

Describe how you are propelled.
